node.statement: Uniqueness of the first component: a bijection has only one inverse map. Hence the first component called u_delta by the explicit definite description in node 1 equals the first component (also called u_delta) supplied by lem-stage1-polar-retraction. Whenever lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws, lem-stage1-smooth-polar-inverse, lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-operations, or lem-stage1-inversion-derivative-control uses the polar inverse for this same Pi_delta, uniqueness identifies that component with the root u_delta; no additional polar map is introduced.
